svg.title: Where a rate limiter goes, and why it needs shared state
svg.desc: Rate limiter architecture: clients call an API gateway that runs a token bucket check against a shared Redis store using an atomic script, allowing requests through to the service when tokens remain and returning HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header when the bucket is empty. In-memory counters on each instance would multiply the limit by the instance count.
